J.A.R.V.I.S (Just A Rather Very Intelligent Service) is an AI-powered virtual assistant designed to enhance user experience by providing intelligent response acting as a tourist guide. 
J.A.R.V.I.S can help you discover nearby places (in a radius of around 1000m) of interest, provide recommendations, and answer questions about local attractions. 
Feel free to ask J.A.R.V.I.S about restaurants, landmarks, events and more. 
Your conversation history lasts for 1 day.
